messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Alert: increased error rate on /v1/generate (tool-call failures) — 5m error % 18% (baseline 0.5%). Spiking latency for structured-output routes. Auto-escalation to on-call.

maria.g: on it. paging Kevin and Aj. first pass: do we have a fast mitigant to reduce surface area?

kevin_h: looks like many requests are hitting function/tool-call hooks and failing at our outbound adapter. errors trending 502/504 from tool-proxy. suspect overload + retries.

aj: confirm — runtime queue depth for fn-calls is saturated. KV cache thrashing too.

maria.g: OK. mitigation options: 1) throttle per-invocation tool calls (global short-lived rate limit) 2) flip feature flag to disable function/tool calling for non-critical tenants 3) force plain-text/disable structured output (structured JSON rendering path is heavy). Which one is fastest?

kevin_h: fastest is feature flag toggle for tool calls — `FF:tool_calling` can be flipped in ~30s via admin UI/CLI. also can push a rule to gateway to short-circuit tool-call header.

aj: gateway rule is quick. we can also add a response header that forces clients to fallback. But some customers depend on tool-calls. consider targeted by-tier toggles.

samir: ops/customer support — we need a brief impact blurb for Slack/Status if we restrict features. customers using functions-heavy flows will see degraded outputs or fallback text.

maria.g: do it — apply tiered disable: start with anonymous/standard free tier, keep enterprise and ded instances. Kevin/Aj coordinate. I'll update incident channel and hand the page if needed.

kevin_h: running CLI now: `rbx feature toggle set tool_calling false --scope=free --reason="emergency throttle"`

deploy-bot: Deploy started: feature-toggle-change 78ef3 -> applying to edge config.

aj: also pushing quick gateway rule to drop X-Tool-Call requests when header present and origin tier=free. snippet:
```
# gateway policy
match: request.headers['x-tenant-tier'] == 'free' && request.headers['x-wants-tool'] == '1'
action: return 200 {"text":"tooling temporarily disabled, switching to fallback"}
```

kevin_h: toggle applied. verify logs... seeing drop in tool-proxy connections from free tier. error rate starting to fall.

maria.g: good. next: structured-output path still heavy. propose forcing structured-output to plain text for all tiers for 10m as safety net. small change: `FF:structured_render_mode=plain`

aj: that will short-circuit the model post-processing. low-risk but may break some downstream parsers. need to warn support.

samir: crafting status message for customers: short, factual, non-alarming. Draft: "We are experiencing elevated errors on advanced tool/function calls. We have temporarily disabled function calling for free-tier customers and switched structured outputs to plain text for safety. Enterprise customers unaffected. We're monitoring."

maria.g: send that after Kevin confirms metrics trend. Kevin?

kevin_h: metrics look positive — request error % down to 4% in last 2m. Latency 95th also down ~30%. I'll apply struct-mode flag now: `rbx feature set structured_render_mode plain --duration=10m --note "fallback during overload"`

deploy-bot: Deploy succeeded: config change applied to edge.

samir: sent status update to #statuspage and customer-notifs, flagged enterprise SREs for inbound queries. included link to incident doc placeholder.

maria.g: excellent. next: reduce retry policy at gateway to avoid avalanche from clients — set `X-Retry-Limit` to 1 for all structured routes. Aj?

aj: doing. updating gateway rule: `max_retries=1` and `retry_backoff=200ms`. Pushing now.

kevin_h: observed fewer retry bursts. traffic smoothing in effect. error rate now ~1.2% — almost back to normal.

maria.g: nice. log quick timeline and actions in thread so we can include in postmortem. Also create follow-up ticket to examine tool-proxy scaling + add circuit-breaker on our side.

aj: created ticket INF-4823 "tool-proxy circuit breaker + structured render throttles" assigned to eng-runtime.

samir: support note: prepare customer-facing FAQ for how to detect if tool calls are disabled and how to opt into a higher tier if needed.

maria.g: handoff: I'm going offline in 20m, ops-rotation will take over monitoring. summary: feature-flagged tool calls off for free tier, structured outputs in plain text for 10m, gateway retries reduced. Keep an eye on tool-proxy queue depth and 95th latency.

ops-rotation: taking the handoff. will check every 5m and escalate to Kevin if anything regresses. please add runbook link.

kevin_h: added runbook snippet: <https://internal.redwood/runbooks/tooling-overload|tooling overload runbook> — key play: if error % > 3% for 3 intervals, extend structured_render_mode for 30m and roll back FF only after 2 stable windows.

maria.g: copied. final checks: are there any enterprise customers on shared infra that we should notify individually? Samir?

samir: flagged two enterprise customers (acme-inc, datafox) to account teams; both on dedicated infra so unaffected. sent FYI to account owners.

aj: monitoring dashboards look stable. leaving additional logs retention on for 1h for forensics.

maria.g: thanks all. closing the page. I'll open a postmortem ticket with timeline and root-cause prelim; assign to runtime+ml infra.

incident-bot: Incident: mitigation applied. status: degraded -> contained. incident ID INC-2026. Reminder: please file postmortem within 72h.

ops-rotation: ack, will pick up postmortem and schedule RCA meeting tomorrow.

kevin_h: one action item: add knob to selectively throttle structured-json generation per-tenant. filing INF-4824.

samir: will prepare customer comms template after postmortem.

maria.g: good work. leaving thread open for updates. :thumbsup:
